messages:
marta (eng-security): FYI: security scan found multiple outdated libs in base images. Plan rebuild + replace minimal setuid tools, tighten seccomp and rotate signing keys. Need infra + runtime coordination for a safe rollout.

dan (eng-infra): Acknowledge. We'll provision an HSM-backed key and keep the existing KMS key for dual-sign during transition. Need a 3h window to grant signer SA roles/cloudkms.signer.

yuki (eng-runtime): Admission controller currently requires a single trusted signature. We should allow either key during cutoff. Also flag: two services use loop mounts and CAP_SYS_ADMIN; seccomp-strict will break them.

oncall (ops-bot): CI note: some internal builders use setuid for mounting loop devices. Ops can provide a 48h privileged shim for those runners. Please publish list of affected runners.

marta (eng-security): Action items: 1) @dan open IAM PR with least-privilege + time-limited grant, 2) @yuki patch admission controller to accept either signature for canary, 3) ops list CI runners needing shims. I'll draft runbook and retention spec for audit logs (365d).

dan (eng-infra): RBAC example we will include in PR:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/signer \ 
  --member=serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com \ 
  --role=roles/cloudkms.signer
```

yuki (eng-runtime): Cosign dual-sign example for runbook:
```
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/repo/cryptoKeys/old-signer image:patched
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/hsm/cryptoKeys/hsm-signer image:patched
```

marta (eng-security): Compliance asks for structured audit fields: event_ts, signer.key_id, image.ref, image.digest, action(rebuild/sign). Please ensure audit-exporter maps these fields and SIEM retention >=365 days.

oncall (ops-bot): Canary build queued: 7600123456-canary. Monitoring hooks in place.

yuki (eng-runtime): Running seccomp-strict canary now on 5% pools. Will report failures in 20m.

marta (eng-security): Scheduling preflight 18:00 UTC tomorrow to review PRs and runbook. If new setuid usages found, tag them asap.
